license.copy: Unmodified license bytes from the public fixed-commit source archive.

adaptation.scope: Behavioral contract adaptation and newly written Traditional Chinese prompts for SCEAN chapter analysis and chapter summaries; not a wholesale copy or import of the upstream application.
derivedBehaviors: Threshold and protected recent buffer before endpoint selection.
Endpoint analysis followed by one structured chapter summary.
Structured title, summary, keywords, characters, locations, plotThreads and emotionalTone.
Summary detail modes concise, auto and precise.
notImported: PromptPack database contents or private prompt overrides
Upstream style review, lore management, chapter timeline or history-evidence pipelines
Runtime, credentials, private stories or sessions
adaptation.promptLanguageNote: Fixed source templates are English. Traditional Chinese prompts are an explicit new adaptation, not a recovered live ZEOLAS prompt.
sceanSpecificChanges: SCEAN uses complete committed input/body turns instead of upstream individual StoryEntry messages.
Strict integer endpoint and canonical commit identity validation replaces upstream endpoint clamping.
Bounded source and prior-chapter context replaces upstream unbounded previous chapter summaries.
SCEAN aggregate persistence, receipts, source invalidation, cancellation and recovery remain local contracts.
